description: Find expiring, pending-delete and just-dropped domains ranked by a verified quality score (0-100) built from sampled Wayback snapshots (real site vs parked/for-sale), Common Crawl presence, dictionary/brandability and spam heuristics; Majestic referring subnets only count when the archive shows a real site. Parked and spam names are hidden by default; each item includes quality_reasons. Free tier returns top 25; status=available names can be bought immediately with create_order. For presets, estimated value, multi-TLD and keyword filters use drop_radar.

drops_within_days.description: pending-delete names dropping within N days

order.description: sort direction; default depends on sort

show_parked.description: include names whose archive shows only parked/for-sale pages (hidden by default)

name: find_dropping_domains
title: Find expiring domains
